pre_commit.description: Verifies that Presentation layer never directly references LexoraDbContext or EF Core, and Domain remains pure.
Verifies 100% key parity between vi-VN and en-US localization dictionaries.
Verifies that Spaced Repetition (SM-2) engine tests pass and EF >= 1.3 invariant is preserved.
Runs silent build to enforce 0 warnings and 0 errors before commits.

post_edit.description: Reminds or checks that user-facing changes have an entry in CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] or changelog/unreleased/.
post_edit.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (-not (Test-Path changelog/unreleased/*.md) -and -not (Select-String -Path CHANGELOG.md -Pattern '\[Unreleased\]' -Quiet)) { Write-Warning 'Remember to create a changelog fragment in changelog/unreleased/ using bump_changelog.ps1' }"
